## 2

I understand why some images can seem difficult to verify on their own, but the evidence for a round Earth comes from many independent sources—not just photographs. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible at different latitudes, Earth casts a round shadow during lunar eclipses, and satellites, GPS, and global communications all rely on a spherical Earth model. Photos from space are only one part of a much larger body of evidence.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny gas molecules. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky. Violet is scattered even more, but our eyes are less sensitive to it, and some violet is absorbed higher in the atmosphere. That is why the sky usually looks blue.

## 4

雨落在深夜的城市里，像一层细密而透明的帘子，遮住了远处的灯火。街道被水洗得发亮，路灯映在积水中，随着风吹泛起金色的波纹。屋檐不断滴水，清脆的声响落在寂静里，仿佛有人轻轻敲门。偶尔一辆车驶过，车轮卷起白雾，也把孤单的影子拖得很长。窗内的灯光温暖而安静，茶杯升起淡淡的热气。这样的夜晚让人想起许多往事，却又愿意暂时什么都不说，只听雨声慢慢陪自己入睡。
